item.title: Australia: Building Digital Trust in the Age of Generative AI
item.description: UNSW researchers show how consumer AI-powered bots can dominate social media, significantly distort online debate and materially influence election outcomes, highlighting urgent digital literacy needs.

item.title: The Philippines: SEC’s Digital Tools Support MSMEs, Investors
item.description: The SEC–Laoag Extension Office has expanded digital services, including the SEC-ZERO platform, to streamline business registration, enhance investor protection and support MSMEs across northern Luzon.

item.title: Hong Kong: International Standards to Drive Emerging Tech Adoption
item.description: Hong Kong Productivity Council and BSI Hong Kong partner to embed international standards into regional industries, enhancing innovation, cybersecurity, AI, ESG practices and cross-border interoperability.

item.title: ASEAN Strengthens Digital Cooperation with Hanoi Declaration
item.description: ASEAN Digital Ministers adopt the Hanoi Declaration, decisively strengthening regional digital cooperation, AI integration, innovation and inclusive, secure and truly sustainable digital transformation across the bloc.

item.title: Singapore: Advancing ASEAN Digital Security and Resilience
item.description: Singapore is actively contributing to regional efforts to enhance digital security, combat cross-border scams and strengthen infrastructure resilience while promoting innovation and collaboration across ASEAN.

item.title: Australia: Cybersecurity Essentials for SMEs Using Cloud AI
item.description: Australia’s new guidance helps SMEs adopt cloud-based AI securely, emphasising data protection, risk management and robust cybersecurity measures as key enablers of innovation and business resilience.

item.title: Vietnam: AI and Cloud Fuel Data Centre Investment Boom
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City is rapidly emerging as a leading regional hub for billion-dollar hyperscale data centre investments, driven by AI adoption, cloud demand and strong government support for digital infrastructure.

item.title: Hong Kong: SMEs Embrace AI, Digital Tools Amid Caution
item.description: Hong Kong SMEs remain cautiously optimistic in early 2026, investing steadily in technology and AI to enhance productivity, digital transformation and navigate rising costs amid uneven sectoral conditions.

item.title: India: Developing Next-Generation Chip Design Talent
item.description: India’s Chips to Start-up Programme is accelerating domestic semiconductor design by training thousands, enabling startups and building a skilled, industry-ready workforce for a competitive innovation ecosystem.

item.title: Singapore: Tech and Training Shape the Future of Healthcare
item.description: Singapore is actively leveraging technology, AI and flexible workforce training to transform healthcare delivery, ensuring high-quality patient-centred care while preparing professionals for a digital future.
